newsitem.title: UK: 400 mln stg in UK bond tranches exhausted - BoE.
newsitem.headline: 400 mln stg in UK bond tranches exhausted - BoE.

text.p: The Bank of England said on Tuesday that 400 million stg of index-linked stock tranches issued earlier in the day were exhausted and no longer operating as taps.
The Bank had opened 100 million stg of 2-1/2 percent index-linked Treasury stock due 2009 and 300 million stg of 2-1/2 percent Treasury stock due 2016. Both taps were exhausted by 1000 GMT.
The certified price for the 2009 stock was 172.08 and 60 percent of bids were allotted at that price.
For the 2016 stock, the strike price was 156.16. 10 percent of bids were allotted at that price.
